tasks.label: LiteBox: Build All
args: cd /mnt/c/src/litebox-vscode-server && cargo build -p litebox_tool_executor -p litebox_broker -p litebox_runner_linux_userland -p litebox_test_harness && cargo rustc -p litebox_test_harness --target-dir target/nonpie -- -C link-args=-no-pie

tasks.label: LiteBox: Build Docker Images
tasks.command: docker build --target litebox-vscode -t litebox-vscode -f C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\litebox_tool_executor\rootfs\Dockerfile C:\src\litebox-vscode-server && docker build --target litebox-test -t litebox-test -f C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\litebox_tool_executor\rootfs\Dockerfile C:\src\litebox-vscode-server

tasks.label: LiteBox: Start VS Code Server
tasks.command: docker rm -f litebox-vscode 2>$null; docker run --rm --name litebox-vscode -p 2222:22 --cap-add SYS_PTRACE -v C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\target\debug:/opt/litebox:ro -v C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\litebox_tool_executor\policies:/opt/policies:ro litebox-vscode /opt/litebox/litebox_tool_executor --rootfs / --vscode-server --ssh-port 22 --policy /opt/policies/demo-policy.json

tasks.label: LiteBox: Start VS Code Server (Record Baseline)
tasks.command: docker rm -f litebox-vscode 2>$null; docker run --rm --name litebox-vscode -p 2222:22 --cap-add SYS_PTRACE -v C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\target\debug:/opt/litebox:ro litebox-vscode /opt/litebox/litebox_tool_executor --rootfs / --vscode-server --ssh-port 22 --record-baseline
